name: Stop
doc: Stop (the spell): the root - every 20 ticks the target task of the next action on its first target: the clock's keyframed prim-model play in front of the target, a screen fade, the clock pieces breaking into 514 flying, spinning, fading shards, the sound; the status. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag119_stop.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pool and shard buffer in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Target
parts.doc: One target task an action on its first target: the clock's keyframed prim-model play in front of the target, the screen fade, the clock pieces breaking into shards, the sound; the status

params.label: Status tick
params.doc: The status (the action's result) at this tick of the target task

params.label: Clock
params.doc: The prim-model layout clock (its models' animation)
